requiredPatchContract.appEntryHook: App.tsx side-effect import writes a nonce-named Paths.cache receipt at actual JS bundle entry.
requiredPatchContract.resumeHook: TrainingLifecycleUseCases.resumeActiveSession wraps only resolveRuntimeForSession(session), preserving the exact returned value or rethrowing the identical error object.
requiredPatchContract.mismatchPredicate: Only the exact OOD v23 session track/version/hash plus TrainingApplicationFailure code resume_unavailable plus the exact current resolver no-match Error cause writes identity_mismatch.
requiredPatchContract.externalPrivateBinding: Map fresh nonce to base ref, patch/helper hash, app bundle tree hash, embedded JS hash, and expected content identity outside the receipt; do not embed final build hash into itself or upload the instrumented bundle.

otaResolution: A cached update cannot create a fresh post-build CSPRNG nonce receipt unless it contains that nonce. The test tool must never upload the instrumented bundle. Missing or stale nonce receipt is inconclusive and fails closed.
gates: Before patching exact refs or building Release apps, run a bounded current-Debug Paths.cache create/write/read/delete probe against one dedicated own file using the existing approved JS console; validate exact receipt keys/value and delete only that file.
No source-backed evidence identified the current approved JS console mechanism; its availability remains an operational prerequisite to confirm before the probe.

Patch diff may alter only test helper, App.tsx entry import, and resumeActiveSession wrapper; do not change product config, native project, dependencies, schema, generated content, lock, scoring, selection, storage contracts, or current app source.
Focused tests must prove receipt allowlist/stages, exact mismatch predicate, no false mismatch for other failures, and original value/error identity preservation.
At actual v24 run require fresh v24 entry receipt and exact v23 mismatch receipt; UI remains fail-closed with unanswered session unchanged. Any missing/stale/unexpected receipt is inconclusive.
Verify v23 old session via ordinary UI, same app identity install, Guest preservation categories, own-session cleanup, current-app restoration, and required SDK/OS/API state.
limitations: Cache can be evicted; absence must fail closed and only exact nonce paths may be read or deleted.
Instrumented test builds add tiny synchronous I/O. The outcome cannot be represented as an unmodified-release test.
